# TheAmericanDeal.org: The National Sovereignty and Resilience Act (NSRA)

> The NSRA is a citizen-drafted federal DISCUSSION DRAFT. It has NOT been introduced in, considered by, or passed by either chamber of Congress. It is a 40-title, 260-section bill on household costs: $0-deductible baseline health coverage, G7-median drug pricing, a $35 insulin cap, a 50-home-per-metro institutional homebuyer cap, zero-interest federal student loans, a full congressional stock trading ban, self-funded paid family leave, federal R&D restored to 1% of GDP, and permits on a fixed clock. It is open to adoption by any sponsor. Fiscal figures are internal models on the CBO February 2026 baseline, not official CBO/JCT scores. Drafted by Santonio D. Sanders. Not affiliated with any party, PAC, or elected official.
